preconditions.description: Number of vertices n is within the specified range.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the valid range.

postconditions.description: The number of transformations k is within the specified range.
The number of transformation lines matches the declared number of transformations.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and 1 <= y_prime <= n for x, y, y_prime in transformations)
postconditions.description: Each transformation involves valid vertex indices.

postconditions.expression: sum(d**2 for d in distances) == min_sum_of_squares
postconditions.description: The sum of squared distances between all pairs of vertices is minimized.
